title: Disengagement
summary: DISENGAGEMENT, noun 1. A setting free; separation; extrication. It is easy to render this disengagement of caloric and light evident to the senses. 2. The act of separating or detaching. 3. Liberation

inlines.v: DISENGAGEMENT, noun 1. A setting free; separation; extrication. It is easy to render this disengagement of caloric and light evident to the senses. 2. The act of separating or detaching. 3. Liberation or release from obligation. 4. Freedom from attention; vacancy; leisure.
